WHAT: parse_history_item in service.rs was rewritten to be maximally resilient
WHERE: src-tauri/src/features/history/service.rs
HOW:
  - Only hard requirement: meta.json is valid JSON with non-empty `transcript` field
  - created_at: JSON parse → folder name parse → file mtime → Unix epoch (3 fallbacks)
  - folder_name: folder path → empty string
  - id: JSON → folder name → folder path
  - All other fields (source, model_path, segments, etc.) use .unwrap_or_default()
  - No `?` operators on optional fields — nothing is silently dropped
WHY: Old code had `?` on created_at parse, silently dropping 1,534 valid recordings
GOTCHA: parse_timestamp_from_folder_name must handle both `_` and `T` separators (2025-07-28T18-56-27 format)
